hero.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
hero.description: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

latest.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
latest.description: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

latest.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
latest.description: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick says the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

latest.title: BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with 2% target for first time since 2013
latest.description: The BOJ declared that its underlying inflation target of 2% has been met, the first time the central bank has done so since it set the target in 2013.

latest.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
latest.description: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

latest.title: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'
latest.description: Israel's election leaves the country facing weeks of coalition bargaining and an uphill battle for the opposition party to form a majority government.

latest.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
latest.description: Binance estimated the impact of a security incident at $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in crypto assets frozen, and pledged to cover all losses.

latest.title: Some Polymarket user funds stolen by hackers; exchange referring matter to U.K. authorities
latest.description: The outage comes just days before the platform is expected to experience heightened trading during the U.S. midterm elections.

latest.title: DOJ escalates Alaska Senate lawsuit over dueling Sullivan candidacies
latest.description: Alaska's election could determine which party has a majority in the Senate. GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan faces a strong challenge from Democrat Mary Peltola.

latest.title: Intel plunges on a major guidance miss. What went wrong — and how to proceed
latest.description: Further downside is certainly possible, but selling now won't erase the losses we've taken.

latest.title: Intel stock plunges 21% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
latest.description: Intel has been a Wall Street darling this year due to its emergence as a player in AI, but the company is being weighed down by a struggling PC market.

latest.title: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
latest.description: Microsoft boasts a strong credit rating and has managed to maintain positive free cash flow, unlike Meta, Alphabet and Amazon.

latest.title: Reddit shares sink on weak sales guidance and plans login requirement test as Google search traffic shrinks
latest.description: Reddit posts third-quarter earnings and reveals plans to require all users to create official accounts as Google search traffic shrinks

latest.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
latest.description: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

latest.title: How elections worldwide are testing Trump’s influence abroad
latest.description: Recent election losses by leaders linked to Trump have prompted questions about whether his influence over the global right is weakening.

latest.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
latest.description: Binance says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

latest.title: Binance hack rattles markets as BNB falls 8%, Bitcoin nears $77K
latest.description: Bitcoin, Ether and the broader crypto market took a dive as Binance suffered a multibillion-dollar hack.

latest.title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
latest.description: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.

latest.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
latest.description: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

latest.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
latest.description: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while its earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations.

latest.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
latest.description: Amazon's cloud signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue to exceed consensus.
